title: Hats on!
goalText: Match all 9 items using the clues.
coachText: Swipe the hats right. Red wraps back to Mia.

tutorial.title: Read a clue. Make a match.
paragraphs: The clue cards tell you who gets each item. Slide the items under the right person.
Read the Hat clues above the board. Then try one swipe with me.
